cardText: Merge matching file sizes from 2 KB toward a 1 PB supercluster.

seo.description: Merge matching file-size tiles in this free 2048-style browser puzzle. No uploads or sign-up.
seo.intro: Slide matching file-size tiles together to grow from kilobytes to megabytes, gigabytes, terabytes, and the 1 PB goal.
steps: Use arrow keys, swipe, or the direction buttons to move every tile.
Matching neighboring sizes merge into the next size.
Keep space open and try to reach the 1 PB tile.
faqs: No. This is a local puzzle and never reads or uploads your files.

cardText: Fill intersecting file-extension clues so every row and column matches its regular expression.

seo.description: Solve a compact regex crossword using familiar file extensions. Free, private, and playable in your browser.
seo.intro: Use row and column patterns to fill a small crossword of file extensions. Every crossing must satisfy both clues.
steps: Click a cell to cycle through letters, or focus it and type a letter.
Use the row and column regex clues to check your choices.
Match all six patterns to solve the puzzle.
faqs: Do I need to know regex?
Basic pattern matching helps, and the clues are visible beside the grid.

cardText: Race the clock while typing snippets of JSON, HTML, and Markdown accurately.

seo.description: Test your typing speed and accuracy on code and Markdown snippets in this free 60-second browser game.
seo.intro: Type the displayed snippet as accurately as you can. The timer starts on your first key and tracks speed and accuracy.
steps: Read the code or Markdown snippet.
Type it exactly into the text box; spaces and punctuation count.
Finish the snippet or beat the 60-second clock.
faqs: No. The snippet and typed text stay in this browser session.

cardText: Match file extensions with their MIME types using as few turns as possible.

seo.description: Match common file extensions with MIME types in a quick memory game. No files are needed.
seo.intro: Find the MIME type for each extension by turning over two cards at a time.
steps: Choose any two cards to reveal them.
Match an extension such as .pdf with its MIME type.
Clear all pairs in as few turns as you can.
faqs: No. They are text labels for common formats and MIME types.

cardText: Eat software bugs, wrap through the walls, and avoid your own tail.

seo.description: Play a file-themed snake game: collect bugs, grow longer, and wrap through the board edges. Free and local to your browser.
seo.intro: Guide the bug-catching snake around the board. Every bug adds to your score and length.
steps: Use arrow keys or the direction pad to steer.
Collect the bug to grow and earn a point.
Pass through any wall to appear on the opposite edge, and avoid your own tail.
faqs: Can I play with touch controls?
Yes. Use the on-screen direction buttons on touch screens.

cardText: Match hex color codes to their swatches and build a streak.

seo.description: Train your color vision by matching hex codes to swatches in this short design game.
seo.intro: Study the color swatch and choose its matching CSS hex value. Play ten rounds and track your streak.
steps: Look at the displayed color.
Choose one of four hex codes.
Get ten answers and see your final score.
faqs: Does the game use my design files?
No. The game uses a small built-in palette and never reads your files.

cardText: Sort a compact Klondike-style card layout into four suit foundations.

seo.description: Play a compact Klondike-style solitaire game with a three-column tableau. Free and playable in your browser.
seo.intro: Move cards into foundations in suit order from Ace to King. Tableau moves descend by rank and alternate color.
steps: Tap the stock to deal a card or select a visible card.
Build foundations by suit from Ace through King.
On the tableau, place a lower-rank card of the opposite color.
faqs: Select a visible card, then select a valid foundation or tableau destination.
